coverage.note: lecturesTotal is the 19 recordings in the Cairn catalog on 2026-10-28: 18 lectures and the Q-learning TA session, which the catalog lists last. Lectures 1 and 2 are covered. All 19 slide decks are on the course site and listed in sources.md. wikiTopicPages counts the eight concept pages and the course-logistics page.

slideDecks.note: Lecture 1's deck (45 pages) and Lecture 2's (27 pages) are transcribed to raw/slides/. The other 17 decks are linked in sources.md.

figureAudit.note: Counts are over transcribed decks. Both were transcribed by Claude Sonnet 5.5 and spot-checked by Claude Opus 5.5 against 1400px renders, six figure slides each: Lecture 1's 24, 25, 30, 33, 36, 37 and Lecture 2's 7, 8, 10, 12, 19, 21. All twelve agreed on structure, series, values, labels and equations; the audits added context or small descriptive fixes only.

images.discovery: inline in wiki/ and raw/slides/; no index file
images.note: Lectures 1 and 2 only. Lecture 1: 16 of the deck's 45 pages, every figure-bearing slide except staff photographs, a meme, clip-art icons, a logo wall, and slides whose only images are equations transcribed exactly. Lecture 2: 15 of 27 pages, every figure-bearing slide except two SpongeBob cartoon stills credited to Viacom International. No other lecture has images.

caveats: Only Lectures 1 and 2 of 19 are covered; the KB cannot answer questions about the technical content of Lectures 3-19.
Lecture 1's recording leaves out the course-logistics slides (5-6 and 10-15); their content comes from the slides alone.
Lecture 2's recording ends after slide 21; slides 22-27 (collecting demonstrations, the embodiment gap, the summary) come from the slides alone.

Transcripts are copy-edited from YouTube auto-captions; students are inaudible, so their questions appear only as the lecturer restates them. Lectures 1 and 2 each have three passages marked [Ed: unclear].
The verbatim captions are not committed; each transcript says how to regenerate them.
